description: Environment setup: install dependencies and verify existing tests pass. Fixes the NODE_OPTIONS issue for running commands.
steps: Run: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd /projects/sandbox/hanashite-tsukurun && pnpm install
Run: pyenv global 3.13.13 && pip install hypothesis pytest boto3
Run frontend tests: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd /projects/sandbox/hanashite-tsukurun && npx vitest --run --exclude e2e/** (expect 111 tests passing, only e2e fails due to no playwright)

Run lambda tests: cd /projects/sandbox/hanashite-tsukurun/lambda && python -m pytest -q (note: 9 pre-existing failures in test_handler.py due to rate_limiter mock issue - these are pre-existing and should not be fixed)
acceptance_criteria: Frontend tests pass (111 tests, exclude e2e)
Lambda tests run (92 pass, 9 pre-existing failures are acceptable)
findings: All dependencies already installed. Frontend: 111 tests passing (15 test files). Lambda: 92 passed, 9 pre-existing failures in test_handler.py (TestSuccessfulRequest and TestSystemPromptStructure) due to mock_invoke returning None - these are pre-existing and unrelated to our changes. NODE_OPTIONS must be unset before any node/pnpm/npx command. Python 3.13.13 via pyenv.
